description: codebase-kg hooks. (1) A PreToolUse search gate: a Grep/Glob (or shell grep/rg/find) aimed at mapped code is denied with the instruction to query the code graph first. Three ways through, none of them a flag the agent can assert: a codebase-kg query grants one search per anchor its answer named plus a buffer, a search already scoped to an anchored file is never gated, and an immediate repeat of the same search is always allowed so the gate can never strand anyone. (2) A PostToolUse nudge on Edit/Write/MultiEdit that reminds you to run /codebase-kg:refresh when you edit source no node anchors on, and periodically once enough mapped files have changed. Both honor .claude/codebase-kg.local.md (search_gate, gate_shell_search, gate_credit, post_edit_nudge, nudge_every, root, graph_path) and SKIP_KG, and both no-op when the repo has no graph.
